description: This file provides an in-memory repository class for managing sessions and messages, as well as an LLM client abstraction for interacting with external language model providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating sessions, adding messages, and calling external APIs asynchronously.

classes.name: InMemoryRepository
classes.description: A simple in-memory storage class for managing sessions and messages with CRUD operations.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: A minimal abstraction layer for interacting with external large language model providers asynchronously.

methods.name: Session create_session(self, user_id: str, context: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a new session with a unique ID, optional context, and stores it in memory.

methods.name: Optional[Session] get_session(self, session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a session object by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[Session] update_session_context(self, session_id: str, new_context: dict)
methods.description: Updates the context of an existing session.

methods.name: Message add_message(self, session_id: str, sender: str, content: str, metadata: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Adds a message to a specific session, updating the session's timestamp.

methods.name: List[Message] get_messages(self, session_id: str, limit: int | None = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of messages for a session, optionally limited by a number.

methods.name: str chat(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None)
methods.description: Sends messages to the configured LLM provider and returns the response content.

methods.name: str _call_openai(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Internal method to call OpenAI's API asynchronously.

methods.name: str _call_anthropic(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Internal method to call Anthropic's API asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__(self, provider: str | None = None, api_key: str | None = None, model: str | None = None)
